from pathlib import Path
import re

for pdf in Path.cwd().glob('*.pdf'):
    source = pdf.read_bytes()
    producer = re.compile(rb'/Producer \\(macOS["'^'"\\n]*Quartz PDFContext\\)')
    data, count = producer.subn(lambda match: b' ' * len(match[0]), source)
    assert count == 1, pdf
    if pdf.name "'!= '"'Kickoff invitation.pdf':
        pdf.write_bytes(data)
        continue

    xref = int(re.search(rb'startxref\\s+(\\d+)\\s+%%EOF\\s*"'$'"', data)[1])
    trailer = data[xref:].split(b'trailer', 1)[1]
    root = int(re.search(rb'/Root (\\d+) 0 R', trailer)[1])
    info = int(re.search(rb'/Info (\\d+) 0 R', trailer)[1])
    first = int(re.search(rb'/Size (\\d+)', trailer)[1])
    page = int(re.search(rb'(?m)"'^('"\\d+) 0 obj\\s*<< /Type /Page\\b', data)[1])

    def get_dictionary(obj):
        return re.search(rb'(?m)"'^%d 0 obj'"\\s*(.*?)\\s*endobj' % obj, data, re.S)[1]

    catalog = get_dictionary(root)
    page_content = get_dictionary(page)
    assert catalog.endswith(b'>>') and page_content.endswith(b'>>')
    form, font, appearance, name, address, rsvp = range(first, first + 6)
    annotations = b'[ %d 0 R %d 0 R %d 0 R ]' % (name, address, rsvp)
    objects = {
        root: catalog[:-2] + b' /AcroForm %d 0 R >>' % form,
        page: page_content[:-2] + b' /Annots %s >>' % annotations,
        form: b'<< /Fields %s /DR << /Font << /Helv %d 0 R >> >> /DA (/Helv 0 Tf 0.13 0.16 0.12 rg) >>' % (annotations, font),
        font: b'<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>',
        appearance: b'<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Form /BBox [0 0 474 24] /Resources << >> /Length 0 >>\\nstream\\nendstream',
    }
    for number, key, label, bottom in [
        (name, b'cafe_name', 'Cafe name', 327),
        (address, b'street_address', 'Street address and city', 276),
        (rsvp, b'rsvp', 'RSVP contact or booking link', 68),
    ]:
        tooltip = ('\\ufeff' + label).encode('utf-16-be').hex().encode()
        objects[number] = (
            b'<< /Type /Annot /Subtype /Widget /FT /Tx /T (%s) /TU <%s> /V ()'
            b' /Rect [69 %d 543 %d] /P %d 0 R /F 4 /MaxLen 100'
            b' /AP << /N %d 0 R >> >>'
        ) % (key, tooltip, bottom, bottom + 24, page, appearance)

    result = bytearray(data.replace(b'%PDF-1.3', b'%PDF-1.7', 1))
    offsets = {}
    for number, obj in sorted(objects.items()):
        offsets[number] = len(result)
        result += b'%d 0 obj\\n%s\\nendobj\\n' % (number, obj)
    new_xref = len(result)
    result += b'xref\\n'
    for number, offset in offsets.items():
        result += b'%d 1\\n%010d 00000 n \\n' % (number, offset)
    result += b'trailer\\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R /Info %d 0 R /Prev %d >>\\n' % (
        first + 6, root, info, xref
    )
    result += b'startxref\\n%d\\n%%%%EOF\\n' % new_xref
    pdf.write_bytes(result)
